question: Can the published metric be reproduced under the same physical and evaluation model?
audience: Researchers assessing decoder failure across noise conditions
baseline: Untrained BP4 and overcomplete BP4; MWPM reference from paper

settings.seed_limit: Author C++ RNG is not externally seeded; record this limitation, do not claim exact deterministic replay.
settings.initial_p_source: Pinned author train_toric_L8.py sets ep0=.37 when m=3*n. Physical test noise remains .045; these are different parameters.
settings.effective_stopping_rule: Stop at 300 frame errors or 45,000,000 words. Author serial loop uses <=; CLI limits are299 and44999999.

hypothesis: The registered metric can be matched under the original protocol; no predicted advantage in the qkp simulator is asserted.
decision_rule: Compare independently measured estimates and uncertainty with reported values or marked visual-reading ranges. A match is provisional until model, split and units are audited; missing code/data or imprecise estimates remain inconclusive. Do not tune on held-out test data.
compute: Smoke: CPU, one thread, small bounded input. Production: explicitly launch after resolving listed blockers; no full training is started by fetch/check.
uncertainty: Wilson intervals for independent Bernoulli counts; bootstrap trajectory/seed-level fits for lifetimes and thresholds. Use three independent training seeds for new training, reported separately.
procedure: Build the author C++ decoder and load released toric weights. The adapter copies sources into the run folder and changes only code n/k/m, decoder iterations, and trained/control choice; all changes are recorded. Score frame errors, counting nontrivial logical errors even when the syndrome matches. Foundational reference: Liu and Poulin, PRL 122, 200501 (2019), https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.122.200501; this newer paper adds public code and weights.
blockers: The released C++ executable defaults to GB [[46,2]] with six iterations; the adapter makes an explicit copy with toric/18-iteration parameters.
Training weights are public; a fresh-training replication needs the notebook settings and independent seeds.
The adapter compiles a serial C++17 copy and records removal of OpenMP includes/pragmas; no libomp is required.
raw_output_contract: See ../RESULTS.md. Save raw outcomes, checkpoint/config/source hashes, environment, seed and noise units.
